title: Have I Been Pwned
description: Breach intelligence API: email search, domain monitoring, passwords and stealer logs.
summary: Breach intelligence API: email search, domain monitoring, passwords and stealer logs.
offersHint: Breach intelligence API: email search, domain monitoring, passwords and stealer logs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://haveibeenpwned.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: hibp_list_breaches
toolsPreview.description: List public HIBP breaches, optionally filtered by domain, spam-list flag, and verification status.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_breach
toolsPreview.description: Look up a single public HIBP breach by its canonical breach name, such as Adobe.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_latest_breach
toolsPreview.description: Return the most recently added public breach currently loaded into HIBP.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_list_data_classes
toolsPreview.description: List the data classes used across public HIBP breach models, such as email addresses or passwords.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_pwned_passwords_range
toolsPreview.description: Query the public Pwned Passwords k-anonymity API with a 5-character SHA-1 or NTLM prefix and return matching suffixes with prevalence counts.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_breached_account
toolsPreview.description: Search HIBP for breaches affecting a single email address. This tool requires an OAuth bearer token.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_breached_account_range
toolsPreview.description: Query the authenticated HIBP k-anonymity breached-account range endpoint with the first 6 characters of a SHA-1 email hash.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_paste_account
toolsPreview.description: Search for public pastes containing an email address. This tool requires an OAuth bearer token.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_breached_domain
toolsPreview.description: Return breached aliases for a verified domain. This tool requires an authorized subscription via OAuth bearer token.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_list_subscribed_domains
toolsPreview.description: List the domains associated with the authenticated HIBP subscription.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_subscription_status
toolsPreview.description: Return the current subscription details and feature flags for the authenticated OAuth-linked HIBP subscription.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email
toolsPreview.description: Return website domains observed in stealer logs for an email address. Requires an authenticated subscription with stealer-log access.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_website_domain
toolsPreview.description: Return email addresses observed in stealer logs for a website domain. Requires an authenticated subscription with stealer-log access.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email_domain
toolsPreview.description: Return email aliases and associated website domains observed in stealer logs for an email domain. Requires an authenticated subscription with stealer-log access.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_generate_domain_verification_dns_token
toolsPreview.description: Generate the TXT record value required to verify domain control via DNS. Requires an authenticated subscription with domain-verification access.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_verify_domain_verification_dns_token
toolsPreview.description: Complete domain verification by checking the expected HIBP TXT record on the target domain. Requires an authenticated subscription with domain-verification access.

toolsPreview.name: hibp_send_domain_verification_email
toolsPreview.description: Send a domain verification email to an approved alias such as admin or security. Requires an authenticated subscription with domain-verification access.
